case: timestamptz[] values through JSON, CSV, XLSX and SQL file writers
contract: The array contains two distinct instants during the New York fall-back hour, a BC instant, positive and negative infinity, and SQL NULL.
PostgreSQL pg_typeof, array_to_json, canonical array text and array_send provide independent native type, semantic and wire-byte oracles.
Binding the driver's array text as timestamptz[] reproduces native array_to_json and array_send exactly; both repeated-hour instants remain distinct.
JSON, CSV and XLSX preserve the driver's exact array text; XLSX stores it as a string cell without a formula.
Replayed SQL restores native array text, JSON values and wire bytes.

native_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract:: -- --ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families and file-writer combinations, spreadsheet-application re-import and other native type/consumer/configuration combinations remain open.
